title: Fix YHash 32-byte error in profile creation

requirements.text: Fix the YHash serialization error that occurs during profile creation by ensuring the hash value passed to the backend is exactly 32 bytes instead of 64 bytes, investigating the ExternalBlob conversion or hash generation in the ProfileSetupModal component

quotes: it is showing YHash must be exactly 32bytes, got 64

acceptanceCriteria: Profile creation completes successfully without YHash byte length errors
User can enter their name in ProfileSetupModal and create a profile
The createProfile backend call accepts the hash parameter without validation errors
Error logging captures any remaining serialization issues for debugging

requirements.text: Verify that the ExternalBlob structure for aadharPhoto in ProfileSetupModal correctly initializes with empty byte arrays that serialize to valid 32-byte hashes when sent to the backend
acceptanceCriteria: ExternalBlob initialization produces valid hash values for backend consumption
Empty photo fields do not cause serialization errors
Profile creation with no Aadhaar photos succeeds

constraints: Do not change the backend YHash type definition or validation logic
Preserve the existing ExternalBlob structure used throughout the application
Maintain compatibility with the Internet Identity authentication flow
nonGoals: Modifying the backend data model or actor interfaces
Changing the registration form or Aadhaar upload functionality
Altering the announcement or chat features
